name: QuickDesk
description_en:
QuickDesk is a product in the CRM category. Its directory profile covers Quotes (Proposals), List Management, Customer Support, Marketing Automation, Project Management, Call Logging, Contact Management.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: prepare customer quotations and commercial proposals; organize and maintain lists used in operational workflows; organize customer questions and service interactions; coordinate triggered marketing activities and recurring campaigns; coordinate project tasks, responsibilities and progress; record calls and related notes for later follow-up. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
QuickDesk 属于客户关系管理软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括报价与方案、名单管理、客户支持、营销自动化、项目管理、通话记录、联系人管理。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用 另有定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：制作面向客户的报价和商业方案；整理和维护业务流程使用的名单；整理客户问题与服务沟通记录；组织按条件触发的营销活动与周期性推广；协调项目任务、负责人和进度；记录通话及备注以便后续跟进。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
